jobs.title: Cloud Support Associate Internship - April 2027 start, Support Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

**This is a 6 month internship starting in April 2027**

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth.

How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

Would you like to use the latest cloud computing technologies? Do you have an interest in helping customers understand application architectures and integration approaches? Are you familiar with best practices for applications, servers, and networks? Do you want to be part of a customer facing technology team helping to ensure the success of AWS as a leading technology organization? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the market leader and technology forerunner in the cloud business. As a member of the AWS support team you will be at the forefront of this transformational technology, assisting a global list of companies and developers that are taking advantage of a growing set of services and features to run their mission-critical applications.

As an Amazon intern, you will be interacting with your peers and the AWS global team of full-time professionals as part of our AWS Cloud Support team. You will benefit from the opportunity to gain experience on our cloud services, hands on training, and learning as you go.

If you fit the description, you could be the person we are looking for. We are a group of smart people, passionate about cloud computing, and believe that world-class support is critical to customer success.

Come build the future with us.

Key job responsibilities

Each day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:

Learn and use ground-breaking technologies.
Complete AWS certifications.
Work on projects that improve support-related processes with fellow interns in other locations.
Design, build and deploy tools/applications for AWS Support Engineers.
Interact with leading engineers around the world.
Partner with AWS teams.

A day in the life

Why us?

The Cloud Support Associate Internship Program provides interns with the technical and functional skills training based on Cloud Support Builder standards.
On a typical day, a Cloud Support Builder will be primarily responsible for solving customer’s cases through customer contact channels (e.g., telephone, email, and web/live chat). They apply troubleshooting techniques to provide solutions for our customers by thoughtfully working with customers to dive deep into the root cause of an issue.
A Cloud Support Builder may also develop, train, partner with development teams on complex issues or contact deflection initiatives, participate in new hiring, write tools/script to help the team, or work with leadership on process improvement and strategic initiatives.

About The Team

If you’re insatiably curious and always want to learn more, then you’ve come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you as an intern.

Competitive pay
Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
Networking opportunities with fellow interns
Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
Mentorship and career development

The internship is a fixed term program, the start date will be April 2027 for a duration of 6 months.

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and leveraging our unique perspectives to scale our impact and grow. Amazon has 13 affinity groups (https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups), sometimes known as employee resource groups, which bring employees together across businesses and locations around the world. With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work.

If you have a disability and need an adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT): https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/uk

Basic Qualifications

Currently enrolled in or will receive a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Tech with a graduation date in 2028
Basic knowledge of at least one functional scripting language (e.g., Perl, Python, Ruby, shell scripting).
Basic knowledge of Networking and Databases.
Basic knowledge of Operation Systems Windows and/or Linux.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of internet fundamentals and cloud computing concepts.
Familiarity with Database, Storage, & Big Data concepts.
Knowledge of Networking fundamentals like CIDR notations, OSI model, DNS, HTTP, TCP/UDP, DHCP, routing, switching, subnets, NAT.
Comfortable working in a Linux/Unix environment.
Customer facing work experience.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building software that powers real-world manufacturing and drives the digital transformation of global production?
Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.

As our new Full-Stack Software Developer
, you'll be designing, developing, and maintaining full-stack applications for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) that support critical production processes across Grundfos's global manufacturing sites. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

What you will be doing

As a key part of the Manufacturing IT team, you'll create impact by building scalable, integrated software solutions that connect enterprise systems with shop-floor operations, enabling smarter and more efficient production worldwide.

Your main responsibilities include:

Design, develop, and deploy full-stack applications using .NET, C#, React, and MS SQL on local servers or Azure Cloud services
Build APIs and backend services for system integration, including SAP and shop-floor automation equipment using industrial protocols such as OPC UA
Collaborate with production engineering, IT, and infrastructure stakeholders to translate business needs into reliable, maintainable software solutions
Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts for build, test, and deployment workflows
Ensure code quality through peer reviews, unit/integration testing, and adherence to coding standards within an agile SCRUM team
Provide mentorship and technical guidance to associate developers while contributing to architectural discussions and continuous improvement

What makes you a great fit

Above all, you're a skilled full-stack developer with strong .NET and React experience, a solid grasp of system integration patterns, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical peers and domain experts in a fast-paced agile environment.

We'd also imagine that you are/have:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
3+ years of full-stack development experience with .NET, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and MS SQL
Solid understanding of software engineering principles and patterns (e.g., SOLID), RESTful APIs, and web application frameworks
Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)

It's a plus if you also:

Experience with Siemens Opcenter Discrete MES platform development and configuration
Familiarity with ERP systems (especially SAP) and/or shop-floor integration using industrial protocols (OPC UA, MQTT)
Experience with Azure Cloud services and containerized deployments

Why you'll love working here

Day to day, you can look forward to:

A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.
Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.
On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

Join Grundfos, apply today!

jobs.title: Full Satck Engineer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Our purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How You'll Make An Impact

The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

What You'll Do

Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.
Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.
Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.
Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.
Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.
Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.
Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

Success looks like

First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.
First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.
Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.
Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.
Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.
Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

What You'll Bring With You

Critical competencies

Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.
Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.
Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.
Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.
Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.
Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

Experience We Would Like To See

We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET
Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React
Comfortable with SQL and relational data
Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review
Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs
Some exposure to automated testing
Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not
Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

How We Use AI In This Hiring Process

We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.
What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

At Planday, we offer you

Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation
On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan
Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us
Flexible remote work
Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities
Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe
Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Agentic AI & Java, SitaWare Insight
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Software Engineer – Agentic AI & Java, SitaWare Insight

Are you passionate about building AI agents that solve real-world problems? Join our Agentic AI team within SitaWare Insight, where you'll design multi-agent workflows that help military decision-makers act faster and safer.

(Junior and senior positions available).

The job

You'll combine software engineering with LLM expertise to design and implement AI agents and multi-agent workflows for SitaWare Insight. You'll enhance our existing AI Assistant with new actionable flows and help shape how agentic AI supports critical decision-making.

Your key tasks will include:

Designing and documenting AI agents, tool definitions, and RAG pipelines that connect agents to internal structured and unstructured data
Building multi-agent sets using orchestration patterns such as routing, delegation, and result aggregation
Writing production-grade code with full test coverage, structured logging, and robust error handling
Collaborating with domain experts to translate customer journeys into agent task decompositions and evaluation rubrics.

SitaWare is central to critical decision processes, so we always keep a human in the loop and build traceability into every AI solution. We're agnostic to tooling:
we work in both Java and Python and choose the framework that fits the task, running models on-premises or with cloud providers depending on customer needs.

Joining the team

SitaWare Insight program has currently close to 45 Systems Engineers, Architects and Test split up into 5 SCRUM teams and we are growing to meet the demand from our customers.

The program is part of a product organization, meaning it consists of a project and people manager, a Product Manager and a UX designer. Part of the program is in Copenhagen and part of the program in Aarhus. Collaboration between teams in Aarhus and Copenhagen is ongoing on daily basis.

The new team is planned to consist of an Architect, 5-9 developers and 1-2 testers.

For our new team within the program, we are looking for 3-6 software engineers at different levels of seniority to join our Agentic AI team and work alongside colleagues who track the latest developments in AI and help decide how to put them to real use. This is your chance to work with modern technologies and contribute directly to the advancement of our product, SitaWare Insight is shaping the future of AI-driven solutions in a domain where the outcomes genuinely matter.

Your Qualifications

We're hiring across seniority levels, so you don't need to check every box below — but you should have a solid foundation in software engineering and a genuine interest in AI/agentic systems. Depending on your level of experience, we expect some combination of:

Backend development experience in Java or similar
Frontend development experience in Angular or similar
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes
Understanding of microservices and message queues
Solid software engineering practices:
testing, logging, observability, and version control.

For senior profiles, we also expect:

5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on LLM or AI systems, building and deploying AI-powered applications in Java and Python
Hands-on experience with an orchestration framework, and a strong understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, embedding models, hybrid search, and function-calling patterns
Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks and metrics such as relevance, faithfulness, and hallucination detection.

Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned engineer, you'll take ownership of your work, contribute to agile development, and help drive innovation and new functionality. You naturally keep up to date with the latest in software development and AI, where new insights, models, and patterns surface constantly.

On top of that you are a:

Proactive team player — you actively contribute to the team's success with a positive attitude and a strong passion for software development
Problem solver — you naturally identify and solve complex problems with attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and precision
International mindset — you thrive in a diverse, international team environment and embrace different perspectives
Continuous learner — you have an innate curiosity, stay updated on the latest technologies and industry trends, and bring innovative ideas to the table.

Travel days:
2-4 weeks per year. This provides opportunities for collaboration and cross-team engagement.

Please note
that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here https:
//systematic.com/int/careers/security-clearance/

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations — you're stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you're always well taken care of. Whether you're into casual games or just good company, you'll find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there's room to be professional and personal. It's not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We're assessing applications on an ongoing basis, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you're welcome to contact us (except week 30, 31 and 32) on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Allan Carstens.

Get in touch

Tobias Falck Jensen

Talent Acquisition Partner

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Compliance / Regulatory Reporting
jobs.description:
The Compliance/Regulatory Reporting technology team at Millennium builds solutions to meet the firm’s global regulatory and reporting obligations. We use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code), cloud-native/serverless architectures on AWS, and modern full-stack technologies (C#, Angular, SQL), with a strong focus on Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and automated testing. The role is suited to engineers who have delivered real-time, mission-critical systems in high trade volume, distributed and fault-tolerant environments.

Responsibilities

Design and build scalable, real-time Regulatory/Compliance applications using C#/.NET, Angular, and SQL, leveraging AI-assisted tools to accelerate development and improve quality.
Model business domains using DDD (bounded contexts, aggregates, entities, value objects, domain services, domain events) with a strong focus on business correctness and ubiquitous language.
Architect and implement cloud-native/serverless solutions on AWS, including:
Event-driven services using AWS Lambda and messaging/streaming (Kafka, SQS, SNS).
Containerized microservices using Docker and Kubernetes (e.g., Amazon EKS).
Build and maintain Angular front-ends that integrate securely and efficiently with backend APIs and domain services.
Design and optimize relational data models and SQL queries (SQL Server, Snowflake) for high-volume, low-latency workloads.
Drive a test-first mindset with strong automated test coverage (unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end) for critical domain workflows and controls.
Collaborate with global business and Compliance stakeholders to understand requirements, shape domain models, and deliver auditable, production-ready solutions.

Requirements

Core Engineering & Full-Stack Skills

Practical experience with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) for code generation/refactoring, test creation, debugging, and documentation
Expert-level C#/.NET and strong object-oriented design skills
Solid experience building Angular applications (components, state, routing, API integration)
Advanced SQL skills for schema design and complex queries (SQL Server, Snowflake)
Experience with high-throughput, concurrent/multithreaded systems
Kafka or similar messaging experience, including using JSON and Avro for data contracts in streaming and messaging
Strong understanding of unit testing, Dependency Injection, design patterns, concurrency, and SOLID principles
Experience with Git and GitHub in a collaborative, code-review-driven workflow

Soft Skills & Domain Knowledge

Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain domain models, testing strategies, and architectural decisions to varied audiences.
